author: /root/scale_engineering
scope: Full nonauthor static review of the fixed-ten portable transport/partial replay wrapper and workflow. Original helpers and exact275e original acceptance functions remain unchanged; this is not an original artifact download, native hash execution or measurement acceptance.

source_span_checks.helper_span_definition: def through last nonwhitespace character plus two LF; source slices, not claimed inspect.getsource runtime hashes

selection_review.complete_API_population: register receives the full before and after run/jobs/artifacts populations. saved_pages excludes transfer sidecars and verifies contiguous pages, exact page populations, total counts and unique IDs.
selection_review.separate_selection: fixed-selection.json retains exact ten entries and full before count/unselected names; it never purports to be the complete301 registration. All existing before entries must remain identical after, and newly observed artifacts remain recorded but not imported.

transport_review.fresh_owned_output: RUNNER_TEMP plus actual receiver run ID. Existing owned root or per-mode review directory is refused; created guard prevents finally writes to a directory not newly created by this call.
transport_review.original_helpers: Fixed fbd6 provides gh_to_file, zip_inventory, expand, original_bytes and the original source/capacity checks without source edits or monkeypatching. Only original_bytes receives a selected-artifacts envelope for its documented byte/closure purpose.
transport_review.archive_checks: Exact original ZIP bytes and SHA; all members decoded with CRC/size/SHA; bounded and safe regular unique members; original ZIP set and expanded directory/file closure must match exactly; original_bytes(full_crc=True) runs again in replay.
transport_review.capacity: Original one-GiB per archive/expanded limit, 512MiB reserve and 128MiB allowance preserved. Actual declared and fully scanned expansion sums are checked before new writes.
transport_review.write_scope: Only fresh owned reception outputs and executable mode on the newly created byte-identical p8-scale copy. No old raw, source or measurement path deletion/overwrite.
transport_review.token_scope: GH_TOKEN only on prepare. Replay rejects nonempty GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN; no network operation is requested there. Hosted networking is not claimed physically disabled.

original_acceptance_review.actual_source_paths: Two separate actual checkouts: controller at github.sha and source at exact275e. The sparse specification is not accepted as proof; original source_identity and validate_build require complete1089 inputs/manifest593cf/GitHEAD/tree, original three scripts and workflow before and after.
original_acceptance_review.source_snapshot_schema: Actual p7 source_snapshot has exactly source_commit/source_tree/input_count/manifest_sha256/inputs; no fabricated source_root relocation or compiler-environment recreation.
original_acceptance_review.build: One unchanged validate_build(build, root=source), including full source/driver, Cargo success/profile/origin/executable copy chain and retained native digest.
original_acceptance_review.capacity: Five unchanged capacity_review calls using source-bound observer, original context/job attribution, inventory, registered free requirement and original completed cleanup receipts. No SDK command is run.
original_acceptance_review.shards: Unchanged validate_shard on repetition0 at1000/5000/10000/50000. Its unchanged inspect_raw reads the entire raw file and verifies all inputs, stages, mutation paths, budgets, completed closure/full15-table parity, fanout truth and all build population.
original_acceptance_review.plan: Each returned plan must exact_equal registered_plan(scale,0,30,30,12648430,18000000,CAPACITY_PROFILE). 14 samples at1k and9 at each other selected scale, totaling41.
original_acceptance_review.native_calls: Exactly9 expected calls through original native_digest: build executable once plus plan/raw hashes for each of4 shards. All argv are retained original ELF --hash-file; no Cargo, indexing, query, provider or measurement command.
original_acceptance_review.claim_limit: A successful execution can qualify only4/150 original shards with41 samples and5 capacity receipts. It cannot certify N30,1500, the full301 aggregate or any TODO.

completion_and_failure_review.body: Any BaseException in the reviewed body or final source/input checks leaves outer receipt failed and returns2. Partial artifacts remain, and always upload includes hidden files.
completion_and_failure_review.final_checks: Before pass, complete controller/source/observer checks repeat and must equal before; replay requires the entire transport inventory equal its input snapshot. Receipt inventories current review outputs.
completion_and_failure_review.acceptance_rule: Require actual process exit0, matching final outer receipt passed/source_and_original_inputs_unchanged, complete original archive/result retention and whole-frame reconstruction. inspection.json is written before final checks and is never sufficient alone.
completion_and_failure_review.limits: No promise that SIGKILL, disk-full during the first report write, failed upload or frame-emission failure can produce a complete failure receipt. A passed inner report without the required final evidence/exit is not accepted.

frame_review.per_phase_files: prepare/source-before,source-after,receipt; replay additionally inspection, with phase-specific names.
frame_review.contract: Per-file header/end duplicate exact bytes/SHA/count; indexed ordered chunks carry byte count/SHA/base64. Decoder must reject missing/duplicate/out-of-order or conflicting frames and verify complete reconstructed file bytes before JSON parsing.

workflow_review.upload: Original reception RUNNER_TEMP root only, if always, if-no-files-found:error, include-hidden-files:true
workflow_review.logical_boundary: Actual controller tree/source bindings and sole first publication remain root's next step; review does not create a ref or trigger a run.
